segments.text: proposition 1 THe indeuour, which by nature is graffed in men to hide the crimes which they haue committed, ſhould be vnto them a bridle to abſteine from them.

proposition 2 By the lawe wherein one was bound to raiſe vp ſeed to him that was dead, neither was the father bound, nor yet they which in the 18. chapter of Leuiticus are permitted to marrie togither, vnleſſe it were brethren.
proposition 3 Chriſt would haue in his ſtocke certeine of the forefathers, which were guiltie of gréeuous crimes, to ſignifie that he would not deſpiſe ſinners, ſo they would come vnto him in faith.
